transaction-scoped advisory lock held for the complete migration run

limitations: PR #1629 and PR #1630 have no submitted GitHub review records; this is a GPT-6 code review record, not a human approval or GitHub APPROVE review.
The same GPT-6 agent authored the D1-01 release-gate patch and performed this review; this is not an independent third-party review.
